dogecoin.text: The community *is* toxic, specifically #bitcoin. Bitcoin does not provide freedom from ruling powers because at this point, only ruling powers can afford to buy in. #Dogecoin was adopted and loved because, while silly, everyone is welcomed in the community.
Actually, I would argue #dogecoin is the gateway drug to crypto. It’s amazing how many people know what Dogecoin is but have never heard the #ethereum or #Bitcoin
Hate them all you want, meme coins are the gateway into crypto for a lot of people. Thank you, @dogecoin ❤️
